Hollis, I couldn't set up the recurring digest, so nothing is scheduled. Both attempts to create the 08:30 weekday job failed with a gateway credentials error: "requires credentials before opening a websocket". I have no other way to schedule a recurring post.

Once the scheduler is working again, I can set it up as 08:30 America/Chicago, Monday to Friday. It would cover open items in #central-team and #inc-tansley-carrier-api since the previous digest. You, Priyanka and Tobias are in both channels, so posting the digest in #central-team won't show anyone anything they couldn't already see.

Whoever manages the gateway needs to fix its auth or pairing for the scheduler. Tell me when that's done and I'll create the job. Until then I can post a digest in here whenever you ask, so you could have tomorrow's at 08:30 if you ping me then.
